::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
One of the first DLI-backed startups to have chips fabricated at TSMC on 12nm. Product line spans sub-1W IoT chips to 64 TOPS autonomous vehicle processors. Partnering with Zoho on R&D.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Family of edge AI SoCs: Netra-R1000 (RISC-V, <1W, smart sensors), Netra-A2000 (4-8 TOPS, vision + H.26x codec), and Netra-A4000 (ARM-based, 64 TOPS, robotics and autonomous vehicles). Custom Tej-NPU neural processor IP core.
